blocks.text: До сих пор вы говорили о том, что есть сейчас: I am at home. Теперь вы научитесь рассказывать, что было: «вчера я был дома», «на Рождество мы были вместе», «в сумке было два зажима». Для этого у скрепки есть прошлая форма.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
We were together at Christmas.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
Was it warm in spring?

blocks.text: У скрепки две прошлые формы. Где было am и is — теперь was: I was, she was, it was. Где было are — теперь were: you were, we were, they were. По-русски «был, была, были» меняются по роду, а здесь — только по «кто».

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
She was in London last year.
examples.translation: В прошлом году она была в Лондоне.

examples.en: We were at home last night.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: На Новый год они были в Лондоне.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

sections.title: Метки прошлого: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Обычно во фразе есть слово, которое показывает прошлое: yesterday — «вчера», last night — «вчера вечером», last year — «в прошлом году». Праздники и дни — с at и on: at Christmas, at New Year, on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
We were together at Christmas.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: На Новый год они были в Лондоне.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We were together on Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: Если речь о вчера — was или were. Если о сейчас — is или are, как раньше. Слово yesterday или now сразу подсказывает: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
examples.translation: Вчера моё пляжное полотенце было мокрым.

examples.en: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
The shower curtain is dry now.
The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.
examples.translation: Вчера зеркало в ванной было грязным.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Вчера полотенце было мокрым. Как сказать?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

sections.title: То, что не считают штуками, — was

blocks.text: Как и в уроке 4, то, что не считают штуками — крем, еда, сок, — берёт форму для одного: was, а не were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: Вчера крем от солнца был у меня в сумке.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.
examples.translation: Вчера горячий шоколад был слишком сладкий.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: «Не» ставят как всегда — сразу после скрепки: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. Для нескольких — were not.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
The fried egg was not cold.
The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: Арахисовой пасты не было на столе.

fixes.wrong: It not was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: Вопрос — как в уроке 2: скрепку вперёд. Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? Коротко отвечают тоже скрепкой: Yes, it was. No, it was not. Do и did здесь не нужны.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
Were you at home in autumn?
Was your pancake hot?
Were the scrambled eggs hot?
Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: Yes, she were.
fixes.right: Yes, she was.

blocks.text: Чтобы сказать, что где-то что-то было, берут there is из урока 4 и меняют is на was: There was a towel rail in the bathroom. Если вещей несколько — There were: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
There was a public toilet near the station.
There were two taxi drivers near the station.
There was fruit salad in the bowl.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: In the bag were two pegs.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

drill.after: two duvet covers in the cupboard.

blocks.text: С was удобно оценивать прошедшее: That was a silly idea — «это была глупая идея», The plan was sensible — «план был разумный». Для нескольких вещей — were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
The plan was sensible.
The rules were fair.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: We were together on Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

blocks.text: Вся новая грамматика урока — две формы: was для I, he, she, it и одной вещи, were для you, we, they и нескольких. Всё остальное — как с am, is, are.

sections.title: Что взять с собой в практику

blocks.text: Было — was или were. Не было — was not, were not. Вопрос — Was…? Were…?, ответ — Yes, it was. Где-то было — There was / There were. Вчера — was, сейчас — is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: В прошлом году она была в Лондоне.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
Were you at home in autumn?
There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
